verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows broad visa-type guidance: O-1, H-1B, EB-1A, Entrepreneur Parole, and E-3 and TN petitions. None of it is origin-country-specific. There are no pages on consulate processing, country backlogs, or founders from particular countries. Mentions of nationality-linked visa types like E-3 and TN are only package listings, not dedicated country guidance.

support.subject: As a founder abroad, the provider publishes origin-country-specific guidance — consulate processing, country backlogs, or dedicated pages for founders from my country
